programme.desc: Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Film great Miriam Hopkins (1932's "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) returns to the screen to give a show-stopping performance as an overly ripe flapper who will stop at nothing to complete her long overdue wedding night scenario. John Hoyt also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In one of the series' most unnerving episodes, Don Gordon portrays a secret government agent who infiltrates the ranks of the Invisibles -- a subversive, underground society of the nation's power brokers who are possessed by alien parasites.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Martin Landau and Sally Kellerman star as an inventor and his ambitious wife in a parable about aspiration's devolution into greed when a failed experiment leads to the interception of a powerful alien being from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When four brilliant young men born and raised in Spider County suddenly vanish and a fifth is accused of a murder he didn't commit, the boy receives a unique invitation from an alien being who is willing to take him to a home very, very far away.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Ruth Roman, Alex Nicol and Tim O'Connor star in this compelling study of allegiance and sacrifice as a group of lunar astronauts discover a strange space vessel full of fugitives from another world…and they have a desperate story to tell.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Sent to investigate a strange situation on a possibly habitable planet, Dr. Evan Marshall (Larry Pennell) discovers the scientific team sent there is now dominated by a human mutant (Warren Oates) who can exist without sleep and kill by touch!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A drifter wanders into an eerie mansion and finds himself ill-at-ease amongst the eccentric cast of occupants, all of whom may just be part of some strange scientific study…from the dark recesses of the Outer Limits. Gloria Grahame stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: The politics of indoctrination are disturbingly portrayed -- and the Outer Limits is brought closer to home -- as a couple (Macdonald Carey, Marion Ross) welcome their son's new tutor into their home…a tutor whose motives may just be alien invasion!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: Production And Decay Of Strange Particles
programme.desc: An emergency at a nuclear power plant sets the wheels of man's possible destruction into horrifying motion as radiation gone wild tears open a dimensional hole in the reactor! George MacReady stars as the scientist who struggles to find a solution!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Robert Duvall stars as a CIA agent sent on a mission to infiltrate a downed space craft and kill the creatures inside. Mutated to appear as they do, he soon learns that the shape in which a man finds his own humanity is not always a human one.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Vera Miles and Barbara Rush stars as two women who kill a ruthless blackmailer. Fleeing from their crime, they stumble across an eccentric inventor (David McCallum) obsessed with returning the dead to life….including the man the women murdered.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In Harlan Ellison's first ever science fiction teleplay, Michael Ansara portrays a man born and bred to be a killing machine who finds himself without a war when a time warp sends him from a future earth to the present day. Lloyd Nolan also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Star Trek's William Shatner stars as the first man to successfully land on Venus. But when he suddenly starts craving heat -- more heat than humans can stand -- it is just the beginning of a nightmare brought back from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a rescue mission is sent to Mars to discover the fate of a doomed expedition, the Commander (Adam West) and his crew find themselves hunted by an invisible enemy who seems intent on picking them off...one at a time. Ted Knight co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Just Getting Started

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s a case that has grabbed national headlines and rattled a tight-knit Ohio community: Two high school football players are accused of raping a 16-year-old girl while partying last August, and many community members are calling the investigation a cover-up. Are city leaders trying to protect the town’s beloved football program, or is justice being served?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Send the kids out of the room because Dr. Phil is talking about sex! Was the passion off the charts when you first started dating your spouse, but now your bedroom is a dead zone? If so, it’s time to resuscitate your relationship! With the help of Rabbi Shmuley Boteach, host of TLC’s Shalom in the Home and author of the book, The Kosher Sutra: Eight Sacred Secrets for Reigniting Desire and Restoring Passion for Life, Dr. Phil speaks with couples who say they’ve lost their libidos and want to bring back the magic. First up are Joy and Mark who say they haven’t had sex in almost four years. In fact, Joy says the last great sex she had was in 1988! Find out why Mark is terrified to make love to his wife. And, Kim and Adam have been married only four months and say they fight more than they have sex. How can they enjoy the honeymoon phase if they go to bed mad at each other? Plus, don’t miss the top five reasons you should have sex!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine coming home to find your baby physically abused or even dead at the hands of the nanny you entrusted. Brett and Jennifer did all the research they could before hiring their nanny, and then decided to install cameras in their home. Their worst nightmare became a reality... and now their nanny is in jail awaiting trial. Next, a 2-year-old who died in the care of his babysitter. What went wrong, and how can his mother cope with the guilt and grief? Dr. Phil shares the warning signs that can help you protect your children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his intervention with a family torn apart. Carole and Bill have been married 19 years and have six daughters. Carole is questioning whether she wants to stay married, and two of their daughters, Kristin and Jenny, accuse her of lying to them about another man in her life. They say their mother has turned into someone they don't recognize, and they're worried about how the family turmoil is affecting their younger sisters. The 18-year-old went into labor without even knowing she was pregnant. Are the two younger girls at risk as well?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Sarah and Tecoa's mother, Cindy, sits down with Dr. Phil to answer some hard questions about how her daughters' lives have spun so out of control. Dr. Phil shows her some of the video footage of Sarah's life on the street, selling her body, smoking crack cocaine and shooting heroin, while Tecoa explains how it all began. In a race against time, Dr. Phil gets the sisters off the streets and into The Dr. Phil House. Will Sarah and Tecoa commit to rehab and stay clean?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: 80% of all communication is non-verbal, and, as the old saying goes, you never get a second chance to make a first impression. In this episode, Dr. Phil focuses on body language and appearance rather than the words we speak. Learn from one couple how the little things we do can mean more than saying “I love you.” Plus, is she simply a self-confident woman, or are her actions driving men away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you or someone you know is pregnant, then you won’t want to miss today’s show! This episode is the first in a new series on pregnancy. Dr. Phil shares what they don’t tell you to expect when you’re expecting. Parents-to-be, Morgan and Shannon both have Type A personalities. She’s obsessed about her weight. He’s a neat freak. How can they prepare for an unpredictable lifestyle as parents? Then, tag along as they visit a daddy boot camp and a pregnancy gym. Plus, does carrying low mean you’re having a boy? An expert will help you sort out the truth from the myths when it comes to pregnancy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Anthony says he fears his 29-year-old brother, Jamie, a fitness model and personal trainer, won’t live to see 30 if he doesn’t get serious help with his addictions. Anthony says Jamie has struggled for years with cocaine, alcohol and anger issues -- all of which he says are exacerbated by their “enabling” parents, Steve and Joey. Jaime admits to past substance abuse issues but says he has been totally clean for two weeks and has things under control. Emotions run high when this family comes face to face on Dr. Phil’s stage. Steve and Joey admit they have helped Jamie with rent, car payments and spending money, because they say they love him and want to support him. But is that money really being used to fund his addiction? Then, Anthony claims Jamie has another serious issue he needs to address. But the accusation causes Jamie to storm off stage. Don’t miss Part 2 -- will he return and face his problems head-on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Still Missing: Where Is 7 yo Kyron?
programme.desc: It’s been more than three years since 7-year-old Kyron Horman disappeared -- and the case still remains unsolved. Kyron’s divorced parents, Desiree and Kaine, come together in an exclusive interview with Dr. Phil. Hear why they say they believe Kyron’s stepmother, Terri, may know more that she’s admitting.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: At 22, Jael was an aspiring model and finalist on the hit show America’s Next Top Model. But at 28, Jael’s family says she’s losing her battle with drug addiction. Don’t miss what happens minutes before she’s to appear on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can Dr. Phil convince her to stop running and commit to getting well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Family At War: The Intervention (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This is one powerful episode you can’t miss! Join us as Dr. Phil gives out-of-control mothers the tools they need to curb their offensive behavior. Learn how one single mother’s yelling and offensive language are driving away her teenage kids. Plus, one woman gave up a career to be a stay-at-home mom. Now regret and anxiety have taken over to create a potentially dangerous situation for her children. Whether dealing with teenagers or toddlers, every parent knows that unrelated stress can lead to unwanted outbursts. Learn through these courageous moms how you can be a better parent.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked-about guests, Brandon, returns with an update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two moms ask Dr. Phil to give their sons a reality check. Rita says her son, Eric, changed his name to “King Keith” and is forgoing a college education to pursue a singing career. Has he lost touch with reality? And, Cheryl says her college-educated son, Patrick, is lazy and lacks ambition.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.sub-title: I Was Acquitted, My Ex Says Guilty
programme.desc: A woman confronts accusations of her involvement in her son's accidental overdose.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You never think that a loved one could hurt, or even destroy, your family. That's exactly what happened to Donna and her two daughters, whose story begins in a small Oklahoma town in the heartland of America. Donna dated Jerry for five years. He wouldn’t let her break off their relationship and when she finally did, no one could have predicted the lengths to which Jerry would go to hurt her. This real-life drama unfolded with horror, violence and unimaginable twists. See what good Dr. Phil believes can come from this unthinkable tragedy. Is there hope for this family’s recovery?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles his guests' parenting questions. Ken is tired of being torn between his new wife and his daughter. How can this blended family get along? Then, 7-year-old Kailin is a terror to her family. Her parents have tried spanking, timeouts, and every other trick in the book... but could they be part of the problem? Plus, Dr. Phil has advice on dating after divorce when your kids are watching your every move.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's been weeks since Brandon's intervention and reluctant agreement to check into a drug treatment facility. Now, he and his family speak with Dr. Phil as they start the lifelong marathon of recovery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks with couples who have the same fights over and over again. One couple fights every time they get in the car. She blames his reckless driving. He says she’s an annoying backseat driver. Find out what happens when she gets behind the wheel! Then, meet a husband who is fed up with his wife for returning everything—from their mattress to his favorite watch…to her engagement ring! Is she a scam artist or is her behavior a reflection of her past? Plus, Dr. Phil addresses his number one concern regarding parents who fight.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil once again exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge of committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live with the fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Joanna says her rage is scaring her son. Michelle’s rage has driven her to slap her child and hit her with a wooden spoon. Lisa admits to pulling her daughter’s hair when she gets angry. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil looks into the nature of passive aggressive and pessimistic behaviors. One wife needs Dr. Phil’s help dealing with her passive aggressive husband. He never tells her what he’s thinking and often leaves to avoid confrontation. She says this punishment is hurtful and has their marriage in serious jeopardy. Plus, meet a college student whose negativity is alienating her from friends and potential boyfriends. Tune in for Dr. Phil’s cure for this bad case of bad attitude.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The four couples continue with the last leg of the teamwork challenge. After purchasing food at the market, the teams return to The House to cook their meal. Team One again finishes first, while Team Two doesn't even try, complaining about the unfairness of the game. Steve accuses Team One of cheating, which angers Lacey, who hates sore losers. After Stephanie brings up Scott's questionable tactics in the Hitched or Ditched game, Scott apologizes for cheating.Since the women complain that their fiancés don't pay enough attention to them, Dr. Phil invites some good-looking gentlemen to the house to shower the women with attention. While each woman has a one-on-one talk with an attractive stranger, the men secretly watch. All the women except Lilly don't hold back, telling the complete strangers the good, the bad and the ugly about their relationships. While Scott, Steve and Kalin confront their fiancées about what they revealed to the stranger, Tim and Lilly feel out of place, thinking their problems are minute compared to the others'. Dr. Phil has another meeting with the couples, and again asks them to stand up if they think they should get married. This time, only Tim, Lilly and Stephanie stand. Dr. Phil confronts Kalin about his anger and Lacey about her willingness to stay in an abusive relationship. Kalin admits that he needs help and says he doesn't want to be a monster. Dr. Phil tells Steve that if he marries Stephanie, she will make him miserable for the rest of his life. Stephanie agrees, and Dr. Phil points out that Steve just might be a nice guy who happens to love her. Will she stop trying to control him? Then, Scott asks Dr. Phil about how to deal with anxiety and depression, and Dr. Phil offers to help him obtain a proper evaluation and diagnosis. A grateful Scott and Lisa cry and hug each other. And, although Lilly and Tim think they don't fit in with the other members of the house, Dr. Phil assures them that they have a lot of work to do as well to be ready for marriage. He asks all the couples to think about whether they have realistic expectations, and tells them that they are all guilty of contaminating their relationships.Since money is the leading cause of divorce, Dr. Phil sets the couples up with money expert Marilyn Logan, who quizzes them about how well they know their partner's financial situation. The couples answer truthfully, but Lisa again embarrasses Scott by laying out all his financial missteps in sarcastic detail. At the end, Marilyn deems Tim and Lilly the winners of $20,000 from LowerMyBills.com. Go inside The House.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Diana says her 48-year-old husband, Robert, weighs nearly 400 pounds and is in denial about his weight -- and she’s considering divorcing him if he doesn’t get serious about making a change. Diana, who weighs 104 pounds, admits that she often nags and ridicules Robert about his weight and says she’s afraid he’ll die at any moment -- or require round-the-clock care, like his mother did before her obesity-related death in 2003. Why does Robert say he’s overweight? Is he finally ready to shed the extra pounds? Plus, Diana admits that she has struggled with an eating problem for several years. Can she, too, learn to develop a healthier relationship with food? Then, 33-year-old Rose says she weighs nearly 300 pounds and is tired of being overweight. She says her husband, Jonathan, is in great shape, and she wants to be his “trophy wife,” but she needs help curbing her cravings for her favorite foods -- including maple syrup sandwiches. Dr. Phil calls on Dr. Travis Stork, host of the Emmy Award-winning talk show The Doctors and author of the new book, The Doctor’s Diet, to help these guests adopt healthier eating habits and get them on the road to weight loss. Learn about his three-phase plan for reaching -- and maintaining -- your ideal weight. Could it work for you?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They don't pay attention! They talk back! And they absolutely lose control when they have temper tantrums! Dr. Phil's talking about toddlers and their top three behavior problems. Find out how you can deal with them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Although New Year’s day has already come and gone, Dr. Phil’s going to give you the keys to sticking with this year’s resolutions. You’ll meet three women all battling to keep their New Year’s promise to themselves, and through them you’ll learn how to recognize what’s keeping you from becoming the person you’ve always wanted to be. Whether it’s to quit smoking, lose weight or get your finances in shape, it’s time to stop making excuses and start getting results.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Scared Of My Own Father Part 1
programme.desc: Pat and his wife, Sarah, claim they’re scared for their family’s safety. Pat claims his father, John, is delusional, violent, paranoid and so dangerous, that Pat sleeps on the couch in his living room to protect his wife and two children in the event that John comes to the house at night to harm them. Pat and Sarah say John’s delusions have gotten so bad they’ve had to cut ties with him. John, on the other hand, completely denies the allegations. He says his daughter-in-law is to blame for stealing his son, filling his head with evil and turning Pat against him. Can Dr. Phil bridge the gap between father and son and bring this whole family back together again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Eight months ago, 23-year-old Robert Gibbs weighed close to 800 pounds, and fearing he would lose his life to obesity, made a desperate plea for Dr. Phil’s help in a YouTube video. It took two medical vans and five EMTs to get him to the show, and he had to be wheeled onstage. Dr. Phil arranged for Robert to go to straight from the show to Wellspring Academy. Find out how he is doing today! Then, when Susanne first appeared on Dr. Phil she weighed 541 pounds and boasted that she consumed up to 30,000 calories a day in hopes of becoming the world’s biggest bride by weighing 800 pounds by her June 2013 wedding. Dr. Phil warned the 33-year-old that she was on a dangerous path and offered her the opportunity to seek treatment at Wellspring at Structure House weight loss facility. It’s been five months -- how is she doing? See what happens when Dr. Phil pays her a surprise visit. And, hear from Susanne's family members. You won’t believe who she says is trying to sabotage her! Then, Dr. Phil surprises his nephew Scott, who has been at the same Wellspring at Structure House weight loss center for seven months and has lost more than 130 pounds. What does he say is the biggest key to his weight loss? And, how does he stay motivated?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the summer of 2014, a former middle school English teacher was arrested on suspicion of statutory rape and contributing to the delinquency of a minor after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student. In a Dr. Phil exclusive, Jennifer Caswell speaks out for the first time. How does she explain her relationship with her former student?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some teachers today are turning schoolboy fantasies into sexual realities with their inappropriate conduct towards underage students. Mary Kay Letourneau, who admitted to authorities that she had sex with a 13-year-old former student; Debra Lafave, accused of having sex with a 14-year-old student, and Pamela Rogers, accused of sending sexually-explicit videos to a 14-year-old boy, are just a few examples.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.desc: Veteran homicide detective Michael reluctantly partners with rookie Derrick. Witnessing a double homicide, they survive a deadly chase, but Derrick is wounded. The suspects are linked to the kingpin, who retaliates by ordering murders across the city. As chaos erupts, the FBI joins the case, revealing the kingpin's identity. Michael finds a weak link, offering a chance to finally catch him.

programme.title: Kinfolk
programme.desc: Eboni, is a hair stylist dreaming of owning a successful salon in her hometown. Her feuding family complicates her plans, but her dedication and drive, along with the support of her half-siblings Beau and Hillary. Meanwhile, their estranged father's attempts to reconcile with his past create further challenges.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: My Man
programme.desc: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with the charming Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession. When Trina crosses a line, she becomes the target of a deadly game of cat and mouse. Betrayal, madness, and murder ensue as the lines between love, obsession, and survival blur.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: Kill For You
programme.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny’s father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can’t be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programme.title: What I'd Do For Love
programme.desc: Greer Patterson’s happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she’s back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she’ll go.

programme.title: The Groomsman
programme.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.

programme.desc: Mallory is a young ambitious woman with dreams of becoming a successful dance choreographer in the industry. programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver dreams of entering his crop in the Corn Festival, but the dreaded "Bing Bug" invades Hooterville's farms. After learning of his service as a WWII pilot, the locals volunteer him for the perilous task of flying the town's only crop duster.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: How To See South America By Bus

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph�and the barn for Oliver!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: One Of Our Assemblymen Is Missing
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Eb Discovers The Birds And The Bees
programme.desc: Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You Ought To Be In Pictures
programme.desc: The Hooterville Chamber of Commerce attempts to attract a Hollywood film studio to shoot a movie in town. And when a rumor spreads that famous actor is arriving, the townsfolk are all abuzz as they prepare for their close-up, Mr. DeMille!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Home Isn't Built In A Day
programme.desc: Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Trust A Little Old Lady
programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: It's So Peaceful In The Country
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Take Your Wife To A Convention
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Oliver Takes Over The Phone Company

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Count Your Tomatoes Before They're Picked
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Kind Word For The President
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The roadshow visits Lister Park and Cartwright Hall in Bradford.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel hosts from Clitheroe, revealing more interesting valuables. Discoveries include one of the earliest vacuum cleaners, a collection of porcelain pugs, a 17th-century gate-leg table, and a superbly painted plant pot.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel takes the roadshow to Abergavenny in Wales. Treasures include a copy of a James Bond book bought for 50 pence, an art deco dollhouse, and a 17th-century spoon worth 2,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel's experts visit Mount Stewart in County Down, Northern Ireland, where they assess a badly damaged painting valued between 20 and 30,000, a souvenir from Laurel and Hardy, and Henry Sandon is introduced to a mug bearing his spitting image.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team returns to Mount Stewart in Northern Ireland, where their finds include a silver tea set presented to mark an officer's bravery at the battle of Trafalgar, a rare Wedgwood cup and saucer, and a teddy bear that has been in a box for 40 years.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the experts are in England, Woburn Abbey in Bedfordshire. Treasured items brought to light include a rare washing bowl for beards, a portrait of a handsome cat valued at 18,000 pounds, and a Victorian bracelet that imitates a snake.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A Victorian multi-purpose penknife, a miniature theatre, and a Japanese lacquered chest of astonishing rarity and considerable value are among the treasures discovered on a visit to Clitheroe in Lancashire.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents from Scarborough in North Yorkshire, where the artifacts include a rare surviving roll of Beatles wallpaper, the passport once belonging to the world's smallest man, and examples of some of the finest carved whales teeth.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the roadshow team are in St Ives, Cambridgeshire. They assess an early pocket calculator, a valuable jug bought for a fiver, and a traction engine arrives in full steam.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael's experts visit Haslar in Gosport and assess a satinwood secretaire, a radiograph of Edward VIII's hand, an Edward Lear sketch, a gold-painted bronze, a Steiff teddy, and ceremonial silverware given by Tsar Nicolas II to HMS Lion.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael's experts visit Wigan in Greater Manchester. Amongst the featured items are an Art Nouveau cabinet, a cache of silver buried in World War Two, and an early depiction of women's rights.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and his team of experts visit the London to Brighton Veteran Car Run, where they invite members of the public to bring along their prized possessions for expert examination.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit the RHS gardens at Wisley. Amongst the pieces under scrutiny are an early fortune teller's caravan and a credenze with a potential value of 100,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel takes the team of experts to the Royal Horticultural Society gardens at Wisley. The treasures coming to light are a set of letters written by Lewis Carroll and a valuable carriage clock saved from a skip.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the village of Portmeirion in North Wales. Amongst the treasures brought to light are intricate 18th Century mosaics and items made by prisoners of war as gifts.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head for Haltwhistle in Northumberland. Amongst the discoveries made are original fittings from the Titanic's sister ship, the Olympic, a roman coin, and a letter from JRR Tolkein.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Antiques Roadshow team head for the seaside. In Hastings, the treasures uncovered are a Meissan pot, a sketch by artist Augustus John, and an unopened wedding gift from the 1920s.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits Witley Court in Worcestershire where they discover the complete cast of an early puppet theatre, a Worcester plate, a drawing by LS Lowry, and a piece of Staffordshire slipware.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the Magna Centre in Rotherham. Amongst the items brought to light are a rare clock given by Queen Victoria, a stash of silver, and some Beatles memorabilia.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel explores priceless documents, from the Domesday book to the SOS telegram sent from the Titanic and some early papers charting the work of the suffragettes.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Hampton Court Palace to uncover more family heirlooms. Among the cherished valuables are a bronze figure by Auguste Rodin and an early long case clock.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A visit to Hampton Court reveals more fascinating finds for the experts. Among those viewed are a coral bracelet, a rare black wax doll, a dress designed by Vivienne Westwood and a small silver pig.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team takes the Roadshow to Hornsea on the Yorkshire coast. There they find a chastity belt dug up on a farm and an 1875 sewing machine still in use today.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Finds include an 18th Century court dress, a diamond, pearl and ruby brooch, a gift given from the Queen Mother to her Head Chef, and a tin cup that turns out to be a rare piece of silver.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel hosts a long overdue visit to Edinburgh where, amongst the treasures, the team find an ornate Russian cigarette case and a lock of Beethoven's hair.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Included in the day's finds are a hoard of 200 typewriters, a suffragette doll dressed in clothes cut from women protestors prison uniforms, a ring worn by the daughter of Charles I.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Cardiff. Amongst the treasures they discover a painting bought at a bootsale, a rare Prince of Wales tea caddy, and a dusty clock brought down from the attic.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Bengaluru vs Pune - Day 1 Tie 1
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League returns for an explosive Season 2 at the iconic Jio World Garden in BKC, Mumbai. The season opener features a high-stakes rematch of last year's final: the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans, owned by cinematic powerhouse Atlee and Priya Atlee, take on the formidable Pune United, led by owner Riteish Deshmukh. Witness world-class athletes from 18 countries compete in a series of intense Men’s Singles, Women’s Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matches. With the pressure of a "Davis Cup" atmosphere and the precision of tactical "kitchen" play, both teams battle for every point to establish early dominance in India’s premier pickleball league.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Mumbai Pickle Power vs. Delhi World - Day 2 Tie 1
programme.desc: Experience the "clash for the ages" as host city Mumbai Pickle Power takes on their fierce rivals, Delhi Dilwale, in a thrilling Day 2 encounter of the World Pickleball League Season 2. The day begins on a somber note with a tribute to the late Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Shri Ajit Pawar, as players compete with black armbands in front of a quieted stadium.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2022
programme.sub-title: Picklebowl 2022 – Men’s Doubles Semifinal – Wuerffel & Yates vs Ellin & Burrows
programme.desc: Heisman Trophy winner Danny Wuerffel teams up with pickleball pro Kyle Yates to take on filmmaker Doug Ellin and pro Wes Burrows in this exciting Picklebowl 2022 semifinal. Set on the scenic courts of Sea Island, Georgia, this match blends high-level pickleball with star power and charitable competition. Expect fierce play, fun commentary, and standout moments from both sides.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.sub-title: NCPA Utah Regional 2025 - Utah Valley vs. Utah Tech
programme.desc: The grand finale of the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional Championship, the second of six regionals for the season. The rivalry matchup features the top teams from Utah Valley University and Utah Tech.This broadcast highlights the intense Men's Doubles game, where Utah Tech's star player Liam Duffin—hailed as one of the top collegiate players nationwide—teams up with Clayton Boydston to face Utah Valley's duo of Bryce Larson and Charles Case.The stakes are high: teams are competing for $5,000 in scholarship money and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri, where $30,000 is on the line. Ultimately, Utah Tech's first team prevails, taking home the national bid and the Utah Regional title.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.sub-title: NCPA 2026 - University of Arizona vs. Univeristy of Colorado - Boulder
programme.desc: The NCPA Nationals reach a fever pitch in Saint Louis as the University of Arizona Wildcats and the CU Boulder Buffaloes go head-to-head in a high-stakes, best-of-seven showdown. This elite showcase features "smash mouth" pickleball, where powerhouses like Eileen Tran and Frida Madsen utilize aggressive "Skills" to dominate the kitchen line. The intensity explodes during the "Racing" pace of sudden-death points, forcing competitors into a tactical "Freestyle" battle of wills as they navigate a tight center court with no room for error. With the series tied and mixed doubles on the horizon, every serve carries the weight of a national title.

Fearless drivers push their 12,000-pound machines to the limit, featuring mind-bending stunts like Weston Anderson balancing his truck on a single BKT tire. programme.desc: Relive the most jaw-dropping highlights from Part 1 of the 2025 Monster Jam season compilation, featuring elite athletes pushing their machines to the limit in iconic arenas from Greensboro to Chicagoland. From the high-speed intensity of head-to-head Racing to the technical mastery required for a "maximum moonwalk," every moment is a masterclass in raw horsepower. Fans witness the ultimate high-stakes maneuver as drivers like Matt Cody and Briana Mahon brave the legendary Morgan and Morgan backflip ramp in pursuit of freestyle glory. With Grave Diggers "resurrected from the pits" and spectacular "puppy flips" electrifying the crowd, this episode captures the fearless spirit of the world's premier monster truck tour.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: Monster Jam Replay arrives at the InTrustBank Arena in Wichita, Kansas, for a pivotal Round 8 of the Arena Championship Series West. The stakes are higher than ever as the top two drivers in the series—Blake Granger and Armando Castro—face off in a high-pressure JCB Racing matchup that could shift the season leaderboard. Fans are treated to the technical brilliance of the Two Wheel Skills Challenge, featuring daring combos and gravity-defying maneuvers from the likes of Matt Cody in Grave Digger and Tim Hall Jr. in Jurassic Attack. The evening reaches a fever pitch during the Freestyle segment, where "Daredevil Diva" Angelina Nock takes Megalodon to the skies and Cliff Turner hunts for a breakthrough performance in Velociraptor. Witness the passion and raw power as these elite athletes push their 12,000-pound machines to the absolute edge for the Wichita crowd.

Fans are treated to a masterclass in precision and raw power across three grueling competitions: the high-speed JCB Racing, the gravity-defying Two-Wheel Skills Challenge, and a chaotic Freestyle Challenge. programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.desc: In 1909, a Korean freedom fighter plots to assassinate Japan's prime minister on a train journey to Harbin, seeking redemption for his fallen squad.

programme.desc: Champion fighter Yong-hu seeks aid from a priest when strange wounds appear on his palms, leading to a battle against evil.

programme.title: YOUNG DETECTIVE DEE: RISE OF THE SEA DRAGON [English Subtitle]

Starring Mark Chao, Feng Shaofeng, Angelababy. Newly arrived in Luoyang, Dee Renjie investigates a sudden monster attack that destroyed the imperial fleet. Teaming up with hostile rival officers, he uncovers a deadly treasonous plot threatening the highest reaches of the dynasty.

programme.title: A Man of Reason [English Dub]
programme.desc: After 10 years in the prison on behalf of his boss, Soo-hyuk is released, but the boss doubts his loyalty. When Soo-hyuk visits his long-abandoned girlfriend, he finds out that he, now, is a father of young girl. He wants to cut ties with the gang, but the boss is not ready to release him, and hires a notorious killer. The killer takes the daughter as hostage, and Soo-hyuk decides to take revenge in a way that he's best at; violence.

programme.title: Dr. Cheon and Lost Talisman [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The story of a fake exorcist, Dr. Cheon, who is commissioned for the case of a girl who is strongly possessed.

programme.title: The Tooth and the Nail [English Sub]
programme.desc: In Seoul, a soon after acquiring independence from Japanese occupation, two men met and there came the sound of six shots firing. The police arrests Nam Do-jin, the wealthiest man as a suspect for the murder of a driver named Choi Seung-man. However, all they could find was a burnt body, blood spots, and chopped off fingers. As the trial goes on, it becomes more obvious that the murder had been meticulously planned out and carried out.
